title: Orvan sea grain loadings stuck near a third of normal

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: Grain loadings at Orvan Grain Port ran at 32 on the ministry index in November, the lowest monthly reading since the corridor agreement ended.

source_ref.text_snippet: Grain loadings at Orvan Grain Port ran at 32 on the ministry index in November, the lowest monthly reading since the corridor agreement ended.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: The index was 38 in October and 40 in September, according to the Realm Trade Ministry.

source_ref.text_snippet: The index was 38 in October and 40 in September, according to the Realm Trade Ministry.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: Ship operators report that the port strike which began on 14 September is still limiting berth use, though some berths are working.

source_ref.text_snippet: Ship operators report that the port strike which began on 14 September is still limiting berth use, though some berths are working.

facts.subject: Orvan sea route
facts.statement: "The sea route is not closed, but it is not reliable either," said Samir Tolle, a commodity trader in Ravik.

source_ref.text_snippet: "The sea route is not closed, but it is not reliable either," said Samir Tolle, a commodity trader in Ravik.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: The November reading is the third monthly fall in a row and the weakest since the agreement ended.

source_ref.text_snippet: The November reading is the third monthly fall in a row and the weakest since the agreement ended.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: Port agents say the berth shortage, rather than a lack of grain, is holding loadings down.

source_ref.text_snippet: Port agents say the berth shortage, rather than a lack of grain, is holding loadings down.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: Grain is arriving at the port by road and rail, but the store is filling faster than ships can take it away.

source_ref.text_snippet: Grain is arriving at the port by road and rail, but the store is filling faster than ships can take it away.

facts.subject: Ravik Rail Link
facts.statement: Rail loadings through the Ravik Rail Link have risen, but traders say capacity is limited.

source_ref.text_snippet: Rail loadings through the Ravik Rail Link have risen, but traders say capacity is limited.
